semantics.function: parity equals XOR of all eight data bits; appended parity makes total number of ones even
semantics.timing: Pure combinational function of current input, no clock or added cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial value; output follows input after combinational settling
semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly says parity bit is just the XOR of all 8 data bits and lists only in and parity ports

numeric.input: Eight individual binary data bits; signedness irrelevant
numeric.output: One bit, population count modulo two

verification.oracle: Count asserted bits using integer addition and take count modulo two, independently of RTL reduction XOR
verification.coverage: All 256 binary input values, repeated transitions, zero/all-one boundaries and each one-hot input
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait one simulation time unit for combinational settling before comparing with case inequality
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks
